purpose: Validate the first normal Computer Use agent-loop visual fallback task: semantic planner output remains unchanged, OPEN executes semantic-first, an eligible NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET gap resolves a local perception provider lazily through P5D, P5A performs real Computer Control delivery, and task success is reported only after independent post-action visual verification.
requiredClaims: The product runtime and Computer Control dependency exactly match the frozen SHAs.
The test invokes the product-owned normal agent-loop runTask path rather than calling the OPEN executor or P5A directly.
The deterministic test planner emits only ordinary semantic intents ACTIVATE_APP and OPEN; planner output contains no visual fallback fields, provider id, postcondition or coordinates.
The injected planner is test infrastructure only and preserves the same semantic-plan boundary as the normal planner; P5E does not claim LLM planning accuracy.
The agent loop executes OPEN through the existing semantic-first executor path before any perception-provider selection.
A structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET semantic gap is classified by P5B as visually eligible before lazy visual execution-context resolution occurs.
Only after that eligible gap, Computer Use selects the real optional local macOS Vision text-region provider through the P5D provider manager.
The deterministic visual target, primary-display left-click request, explicit allowVisualFallback policy and exact postcondition come from caller/skill execution context, not planner output.
P5A performs real mapped visual perception, deterministic target resolution and explicit authorization before Computer Control delivery.
Computer Control CLICK_POSTED remains delivery evidence only and semanticConsequenceVerified remains false at the delivery boundary.
A fresh independent post-action visual observation using the selected product provider must satisfy the exact deterministic postcondition before VERIFIED_SUCCESS.
The normal agent loop reports the OPEN intent as successful only from that independently verified P5A result.
The built-in perception provider remains local and optional; no mandatory network, account or cloud API dependency is introduced.
Screenshot bytes, OCR payload text and target/action coordinates are not written to session evidence or normal agent-loop logs.
Computer Use and Computer Control working trees remain clean after the session.
nonClaims: P5E does not make visual fallback implicit for ordinary CLI tasks that have no explicit caller/skill visual fallback contract.
P5E does not add visual fallback fields to the LLM planner schema or allow the planner to invent success criteria.
P5E does not claim general OCR accuracy, fuzzy matching, icon/object/VLM understanding, multi-display support or arbitrary gestures.
P5E does not introduce provider selection into Computer Control.
P5E does not make semantic action-delivery failure, semantic verification failure, readiness failure, permission failure or internal exception visually eligible.
P1-P4 physical sessions are not rerun; their immutable evidence remains authoritative.
P5A, P5B, P5C and P5D prior evidence is not rewritten or replaced.
Historical P5C s01-s07 FAIL evidence remains immutable.

evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s01 unchanged, diagnose the exact failed boundary, fix forward only, and create s02 only if required.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: Only test-owned fixture content is used. Screenshot bytes, OCR payloads and coordinates remain ephemeral and are not persisted or logged by session evidence.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: post-P5 hardening or first product skill/caller integration without weakening the validated contracts
